## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4003. The issue was a **Service selector mismatch**: the cart-service 4.2 deployment uses new Helm chart template labels (`app.kubernetes.io/name=cart-service`), but the Service selector still references the old label key (`app=cart-service`). This caused the Service to have no endpoints, making the cart unavailable. The fix is to update the Service selector to match the new pod labels or add the old label to the pod template.
